verdict.rationale: Bruno's local-first architecture (no cloud sync, no account, data stored directly on the user's filesystem, syncable via a Git remote of the user's choosing) effectively lets users control exactly where their data lives, satisfying the spirit of data residency by keeping everything local rather than offering a cloud region picker. missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection UI, any hosted/cloud storage option with configurable regions, and independent confirmation of data-locality guarantees beyond vendor claims.
